notes: Today src/cli.mjs only prints the usage line and exits 2, and src/store.mjs does not exist. T1 creates src/store.mjs and gives src/cli.mjs its shape: the command switch, the usage error (exit 2) for anything but `add` and `list` (`list` stays a usage error until T3), and one try/catch around the commands that prints a thrown error's message to stderr and exits 1. T2 and T3 add their branches to that shape; T3 depends on T2 only to fix the build order, since both edit the same two files. No dependency is added; package.json stays without one.

Storage (D2, spec A1): data/items.jsonl holds one JSON object per line, {"name":"<name>"} followed by "\n", written with appendFileSync. src/store.mjs owns the file: saveItem(name) appends one line, first prefixing "\n" when the file exists and does not end with one, so a torn last line never swallows the next item; listItems() reads the file, drops empty lines (the one after the final newline) and returns the names in file order, or [] when the file is missing or empty. The path is resolved from the module (new URL("../data/items.jsonl", import.meta.url)), so add and list use the same file whatever the working directory. data/ is kept in the repo by data/.gitkeep and data/items.jsonl is gitignored.

Names and errors: `add` takes the arguments after `add` joined by one space (`add buy milk` and `add "buy milk"` both save `buy milk`), then trims surrounding whitespace. Under spec A2 the trimmed name is blank when nothing remains or when a line break remains inside it; saveItem then throws new Error("item name must not be blank") before writing. A missing argument is the empty string, so it is blank. The try/catch from T1 prints the message to stderr and exits 1.

Risks: a crash mid-append may leave a torn last line, and two processes appending at once may interleave lines; the spec assumes one process at a time (A3) and makes recovery a non-goal, so neither is repaired: list fails on the damaged line with its JSON error (exit 1) rather than print a partial item, and later saves stay intact because saveItem starts a new line. A missing data/ folder would fail the append; data/.gitkeep keeps it in the repo.

Checks: item-add (AC1), item-blank (AC2: spaces only, no argument, a line break inside the name) and item-list (AC3) each start by removing data/items.jsonl and run every command as its own process, so each case starts from nothing and list reads from disk in a new process.

tasks.title: Save an item
tasks.goal: `add <name>` persists the named item and prints `saved`
tasks.exitCondition: item-add passes: `add exercise` exits 0, prints `saved`, and data/items.jsonl holds that one item

tasks.title: Reject a blank name
tasks.goal: `add` with a blank name reports the error on stderr, exits 1 and persists nothing
tasks.exitCondition: item-blank passes and item-add still passes

tasks.title: List saved items
tasks.goal: `list` prints every saved item, one per line, in the order saved
tasks.exitCondition: item-list passes, and item-add and item-blank still pass
